evidence.title: FormalTCS: Benchmarking End-to-End Frontier Formal Theoretical Computer Science Research of Large Language Models

summary: Researchers introduce FormalTCS, a benchmark testing large language models' capabilities in end-to-end formal theoretical computer science. The tool aims to assess AI performance in rigorous, proof-based reasoning tasks.
title: New Benchmark Evaluates LLMs on Frontier Formal Theoretical Computer Science Research
